title: ContextGatherResultChunk
description: One result chunk published by the context engine to the RabbitMQ queue `ctx.gather.results`. The API consumes chunks ordered by `sequence`, relays each `data` chunk to the frontend over the existing WebSocket, and completes or fails the planning job on the terminal `status` chunk (`phase` = completed | failed).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Additive-only changes within v1.

job_id.description: planning_jobs._id — MUST match the originating request's job_id.

user_id.description: PG users.id that owns the planning job (echoed from the request).

sequence.description: 0-based, monotonically increasing per job. The API treats chunks as idempotent by (job_id, sequence).

type.description: `data` carries a gathered-context chunk; `status` carries a lifecycle signal. The stream ends with a `status` chunk of phase `completed` or `failed`.

provider.description: Which connector this context chunk was gathered from.

content.description: The gathered context payload — a JSON string or text blob. Opaque to the API; consumed by the LLM planner (roadmap item 5).

token_estimate.description: Optional estimate of the token cost of this chunk, for budgeting.

phase.description: Lifecycle phase. `completed` and `failed` are terminal — no further chunks follow for this job_id.

message.description: Human-readable detail (progress note, or failure reason).

error_code.description: Machine-readable failure code. Set when phase = failed.
